page.layout: One page of text, single column, running text from top to bottom; below the text a closing salutation block (centred italic lines and a signature in small capitals); at the foot a gathering signature "b" at left and "I N" at right.

main_text.l: hostes, fidenter alteram educam in campum.
Sin multi laquei & insidiæ, plane sedet ani-
mo meo, ex fidis silentii castris pedem non
efferre. Finiam cum voto, ut Deus O.M.
cujus virtute, non humana ope aut præsi-
dio, hactenus vestra Respublica stetit, om-
nia consulta & facta vestra moderari ac rite
Anno Salvatoris nostri cIↄ IↄC XXVIII.

page.notes: The signature "b" and "I N" at the foot are gathering marks. The date "cIↄ IↄC XXVIII" is printed as MDCXXVIII. The salutation "observantiss." is set in italic; "Illustrium VV. DD. AA." is italic with the initials as printed. The closing lines are centred and are not headings. Faint speckles and a Google digitiser credit at lower right are omitted.
